name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Residues.change_uniformizer
statement:
theorem change_uniformizer {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (u : k⟦X⟧) (hu : u.order = 1) (H : k⸨X⸩) :
    residue (formalSubstitution u 1 (by omega) hu H *
        (PowerSeries.derivative k u : k⸨X⸩)) = residue H

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Residues.formalSubstitution_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma formalSubstitution_coe {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (u : k⟦X⟧) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e) (hu : u.order = e) (p : k⟦X⟧) :
    formalSubstitution u e he hu (p : k⸨X⸩) =
      (PowerSeries.subst u p : k⸨X⸩)

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Residues.substitution
statement:
theorem substitution {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (u : k⟦X⟧) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e) (hu : u.order = e)
    (H : k⸨X⸩) :
    residue (formalSubstitution u e he hu H *
        (PowerSeries.derivative k u : k⸨X⸩)) =
      (e : k) * residue H

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.EqualChar.cartier_dlog
statement:
theorem cartier_dlog (u : k⸨X⸩) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    cartier (u⁻¹ * LaurentSeries.derivative k u) =
      u⁻¹ * LaurentSeries.derivative k u

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.EqualChar.cartier_residueTrace
statement:
theorem cartier_residueTrace (η : Residues.FormalDifferential k) :
    Algebra.trace (ZMod 2) k (Residues.residue (cartier η)) =
      Algebra.trace (ZMod 2) k (Residues.residue η)

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.EqualChar.cartier_square_mul
statement:
theorem cartier_square_mul (f : k⸨X⸩) (η : Residues.FormalDifferential k) :
    cartier (f ^ 2 * η) = f * cartier η

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Finite.interpolation
statement:
theorem interpolation {p i : ℕ} {zeta : K}
    (hprime : p.Prime) (hp : 2 < p) (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta (p - 1))
    (hi : i < p) (Delta Z : K) (hZ : -Z ∉ teichmullerSet K p) :
    ∑ xi ∈ teichmullerSet K p, (Delta + xi) ^ i / (Z + xi) =
      (p : K) * Delta ^ i / Z +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) * (Delta - Z) ^ i / (Z ^ p - Z)

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Finite.interpolation_derivative
statement:
theorem interpolation_derivative {p i : ℕ} {zeta : K}
    (hprime : p.Prime) (hp : 2 < p) (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta (p - 1))
    (hi : i < p) (Delta Z : K) (hZ : -Z ∉ teichmullerSet K p) :
    ∑ xi ∈ teichmullerSet K p, (Delta + xi) ^ i / (Z + xi) ^ 2 =
      (p : K) * Delta ^ i / Z ^ 2 +
        (p - 1 : ℕ) *
          ((i : K) * (Delta - Z) ^ (i - 1) / (Z ^ p - Z) +
            (Delta - Z) ^ i * ((p : K) * Z ^ (p - 1) - 1) /
              (Z ^ p - Z) ^ 2)

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Finite.teichmullerSet_shifted_power_sum
statement:
lemma teichmullerSet_shifted_power_sum {p i : ℕ} {zeta : K} (hp : 2 < p)
    (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta (p - 1)) (hi : i < p) (Delta : K) :
    ∑ xi ∈ teichmullerSet K p, (Delta + xi) ^ i =
      (p : K) * Delta ^ i +
        if i = p - 1 then ((p - 1 : ℕ) : K) else 0

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Finite.teichmullerUnits_weighted_shifted_power_sum
statement:
lemma teichmullerUnits_weighted_shifted_power_sum {p i : ℕ} {zeta : K}
    (hp : 2 < p) (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta (p - 1))
    (hi0 : 0 < i) (hi : i < p) (Delta : K) :
    ∑ xi ∈ teichmullerUnits K p, xi * (Delta + xi) ^ i =
      (p - 1 : ℕ) * ((if i = p - 2 then (1 : K) else 0) +
        (i : K) * Delta * if i = p - 1 then (1 : K) else 0)

name: LanglandsSecondMainLemma.Finite.missingCoset
statement:
theorem missingCoset
    {V Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Fintype V]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Fintype Z]
    (H : V → ℂˣ) (B : AddChar V (AddChar V ℂˣ))
    (Q : Z → ℂˣ) (p : Z →+ V) (w : V)
    (_hH_zero : H 0 = 1)
    (hpolar : ∀ x y, H (x + y) = B x y * H x * H y)
    (hker : Nat.card p.ker = 2)
    (_hindex : p.range.index = 2)
    (hQ : ∀ z, H (p z) = Q z)
    (hw_mem : w ∈ p.range) (hw : H w = 1)
    (hdetect : ∀ x, (x ∈ p.range → B w x = 1) ∧
      (x ∉ p.range → B w x = -1)) :
    (∑ x, (H x : ℂ)) = ((1 : ℂ) / 2) * ∑ z, (Q z : ℂ)
